rules.contract: Strict UTF8 with optional leading BOM; scalar basic/literal strings, booleans, arrays on one physical line, ordinary tables, bin arrays of tables and flat inline dependency tables. Duplicate keys/tables, malformed tokens diagnose with original spans. Multiline values, dotted assignments, floats/dates and nested inline tables reject.
Any unknown table/key/value in the closed accepted inventory rejects; no ignored metadata.

Package roots, virtual roots and combined roots are admitted. Members/excludes are exact relative directories without globs or inheritance. Canonical manifest paths deduplicate; root package occurs once.

One rlib library and multiple binaries retain name/path metadata. Inference uses existing src/lib.rs and src/main.rs. Explicit paths must stay within package root. Missing files/duplicate target names reject.

Package identity is name plus exact numeric major.minor.patch version; names use ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen and start with a letter or underscore. Same identity at different paths rejects.
Inline and dependencies.name table forms share path/package/exact-version/features/optional/default-features keys; all value types are strict.

Only local path dependencies are admitted; paths may resolve siblings. Registry/git/source requests reject before network access. Optional dependencies retain graph nodes but selection controls activation.
Packages, targets and edges use ordinal stable identity/path ordering on each platform; dictionary insertion order is not observable.
Manifest/source filesystem links reject; source targets cannot escape their package root. Relative paths normalize on the actual platform; cross-platform separator spelling is explicit input.
Default root activation may be disabled. Each dependency edge contributes its default-features flag (default true); enabled edges union defaults.
optional true adds implicit feature named for dependency unless an explicit dep:name mention suppresses that implicit feature; dep:name activates that dependency.
Feature members are local feature names, dep:name or dependency/feature. Unknown names and unavailable dependency feature exports reject.
Feature activation unifies by exact package identity across active edges to a deterministic fixed point bounded by operations/deadline.
Local or cross-package cyclic feature expansion rejects with RSCARGO1008; dependency package cycles use RSCARGO1003.
Weak dependency?/feature syntax and feature expressions outside the frozen forms reject.
Only win-x64/windows/x86_64 and linux-x64/linux/x86_64 are admitted. Predicates are windows/unix, target_os with windows/linux and target_arch with x86_64. Incompatible RID combinations reject.
feature="name" tests unified activation; required-features admit a binary only if every feature is active. Explicitly selecting a disabled binary yields RSCARGO1009.
all/any accept zero or more predicates; not accepts exactly one. Evaluation is bounded by cfg depth, operations and deadline.
Source cfg attributes and target cfg dependency tables evaluate from the same frozen predicate environment before disabled items bind.
Unsupported predicate names/values, malformed expressions and invalid arity yield RSCARGO1009 rather than ignored conditions.

Cargo.lock TOML version=4, package array tables with name/version/dependencies only. Local sources omit source/checksum; dependency identifiers are name plus space plus exact version. Feature/cfg selection is persisted in a companion normalized resolution metadata record with profile/RID/activation fingerprint.
Lock bytes are UTF8 without BOM, LF and sorted package/edge entries. Topological package order is dependencies first with ordinal identity tie breaks. Paths do not leak into portable lock identity.

Locked mode requires existing exact graph lock and matching resolution metadata; absent/stale/incompatible inputs fail RSCARGO1010 without rewriting. Unlocked mode writes only through atomic replacement after complete successful validation.
Self and multi-node path cycles reject even for discovered nodes; graph results never claim success with diagnostics.
Caller cancellation propagates OperationCanceledException; limit/deadline failures use RSCARGO1004. Loading reads bounded files and creates no processes/network requests or outputs.

Multi-package graphs compile through production source metadata/emitter, preserve missing/private/incompatible-export diagnostics, run generated programs and verify CoreCLR/ILVerify/AOT on win-x64 and linux-x64; host simulations do not count.

cases.scenario: A package with name and exact semantic version loads.
All four editions 2015/2018/2021/2024 preserve metadata.
Declared relative members load in ordinal manifest-path order.
Exact relative excludes remove members; wildcard members and excludes reject.
Resolver 2 is accepted; no resolver means 2.
A root with only workspace has no synthetic package.
A package/workspace root includes its root package exactly once.
Existing src/lib.rs and src/main.rs are both retained; library precedes binaries.
Named library with a custom relative path and crate-type rlib resolves.
Multiple named binary tables retain their individual paths and order by name.
Required feature names are retained for target selection by P2-04.04.
An inline path dependency loads its manifest.
A dependencies.name table has the same meaning as the inline form.
Dependency alias differs from package name and resolves the declared package identity.
Optional exact local dependency version must match package version; ranges reject.
Permuting manifest entries yields equal package/edge/target order.
Unterminated quoted strings and invalid headers fail at their exact original spans.
Duplicate scalar keys or repeated singleton tables fail at the second declaration span.
Two different manifest paths declaring the same name and version reject.
A missing declared member fails at its root manifest member span.
A declared or inferred package without a source target fails before resolution.
Unknown package/workspace/target/dependency keys and tables are never silently ignored.
Version-only registry dependencies reject without network activity.
git/registry/source dependency origins reject without network activity.
Source target paths escaping package root and linked manifests/sources reject; dependency paths may refer to siblings.
Hash and equals inside basic/literal strings are data; comments start only outside strings.
Malformed UTF8 rejects; a single leading UTF8 BOM is accepted.
Multiline strings/arrays, dotted assignments, dates, floats and nested inline tables reject explicitly.
Editions other than the four admitted strings reject at value span.
Resolver 1 or 3 and inherited workspace keys reject at their source spans.
Root default feature closure activates unless no-default-features is requested.
Explicit no-default-features permits an empty default closure.
dep:name enables an optional dependency; its implicit feature is suppressed when dep:name is named.
dep/feature activates the dependency feature and local names recurse transitively.
Same package identity reached by two dependents receives the union independent of traversal order.
Unknown requested local/dependency feature names reject at source or option location.
Local and cross-package feature cycles reject rather than being silently accepted.
Weak dep?/feature and unsupported feature expressions reject explicitly.
Dependency default-features false suppresses only that edge; another true edge unifies defaults.
An empty named feature is valid and contributes its activation to cfg.
Exactly configured feature/edge limits pass; one additional entry rejects with no partial graph.
win-x64 selects windows flag and target_os windows path dependencies.
linux-x64 selects unix flag and target_os linux path dependencies.
Both admitted RIDs select target_arch x86_64 and reject unsupported architectures.
feature name uses the unified feature closure and conditional dependencies preserve all admitted metadata.
all predicates require every member; empty all evaluates true.
any predicates require one member; empty any evaluates false.
not accepts exactly one predicate and inverts its result.
Unknown predicates, values, malformed cfg syntax and not with wrong arity reject.
Contradictory RID/target OS or arch requests reject before item selection.
Nesting exactly 16 passes; depth 17 rejects under the shared deadline.
A binary is admitted only when all required-features are active; an explicit disabled target request fails.
Source cfg attributes remove disabled items before binding and use the same predicates as dependency tables.
Cargo.lock version 4 serializes local package identities and sorted name version dependency strings with LF.
Reordered manifest/member/dependency inputs produce byte-identical locks and ordinal topological order.
Existing exact lock succeeds without modifying it; feature/cfg selections are fixed in normalized resolution metadata.
Locked resolution without Cargo.lock fails without writing any files.
Changed package version/dependency/selected feature or cfg metadata rejects stale lock.
Lock versions other than 4 and registry source/checksum entries reject.
Duplicate lock identities or edges and unknown lock keys reject.
Missing/unexpected lock packages and incompatible dependency identities reject.
Self dependency and multi-package path cycles fail even when nodes are already discovered.
Exactly configured lock-byte limit passes; one byte beyond rejects before parsing.
Exactly 64 packages pass; the 65th rejects with no successful partial graph.
Exactly configured bytes pass; one extra byte fails before reading an oversized manifest.
Exactly 64 dependency edges per package pass; the 65th rejects.
Exactly 32 targets pass; the 33rd rejects.
Root depth one through depth 32 pass; depth 33 fails before descending.
Every input token, node and edge consumes bounded work; exhaustion yields a limit diagnostic.
Whole resolution exceeding 10000 milliseconds fails with owned cleanup and no partial success.
Caller cancellation propagates OperationCanceledException and retains no owned handles or files.
A locked two-package consumer compiles and executes exported scalar calls with output 42 newline.
A three-package transitive consumer compiles and runs without merging namespaces.
Frozen feature/cfg selection feeds source-to-assembly integration on both admitted RIDs.
An unresolved imported export diagnoses before execution with its source span.
A private imported export diagnoses before execution with its source span.
An incompatible imported argument or return type diagnoses before emission.
Independent locked builds of the same graph have equal package metadata and PE/PDB hashes.
